item.title: Ontario's police watchdog not investigating alleged assault on lawyer at courthouse
item.description: Ontario's police watchdog says it's not currently investigating allegations that police officers assaulted a lawyer at an Oshawa, Ont., courthouse last week.

item.title: Trump threatens tariffs, decertification on Canadian-made aircraft
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump singled out Bombardier in a threat to decertify and tariff Canadian-made aircraft Thursday, marking the latest escalation of trade tensions between the neighbouring countries.

item.title: Montreal vigil marks Quebec City mosque attack anniversary as Islamophobia persists
item.description: MONTREAL — Organizers of a vigil in Montreal to mark the ninth anniversary of a mass shooting at a Quebec City mosque that left six people dead and 19 wounded say they are speaking out about racism at a time when Islamophobia is high in Quebec.

item.title: Man charged in U.S. with smuggling people across the border from Canada
item.description: A federal grand jury charged an Indian man with smuggling a dozen people from Canada into the United States. The U.S. Justice Department says 22-year-old Shivam Lnu allegedly smuggled Indian nationals across the U.S.

item.title: Man who escaped Toronto jail by posing as another inmate has been arrested
item.description: TORONTO — A man who escaped from a Toronto detention centre on Monday by allegedly impersonating another inmate has been arrested.

item.title: Experts say treason definition depends if you're holding Criminal Code or dictionary
item.description: CALGARY — B.C. Premier David Eby made headlines Thursday by saying Alberta separatists reportedly meeting with U.S. officials are committing treason — but experts say the word means different things in different contexts.

item.title: B.C. school trustee 'terrified' after police ordered her out of vehicle at gunpoint
item.description: Prince George, B.C., school trustee Erica McLean parked her vehicle to write an email on Tuesday after grabbing a coffee, and thought an unmarked police car was trying to park across from her when it bumped into the front of her Volkswagen.
